wacc.source: Assumption via CAPM: rf 4.86% (US 10Y, Treasury 2026-11-06) + assumed beta ~0.8 (pharma, not looked up) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = ~8.4% cost of equity; debt ~10% of capital at ~5% pre-tax cost => WACC ~8.0%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run nominal GDP growth and below the 4.86% risk-free rate.
